intent.summary: Places children in addressable rows and columns with shared track sizing.
useWhen: Items share row or column measurements
avoidWhen: A simple sequential stack expresses the layout

semantics.childPolicy: zero or more children, each occupying one or more tracks
semantics.sizing: tracks may be intrinsic, fixed, proportional, or constrained
semantics.ordering: semantic order is independent of cell coordinates and defaults to document order

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Ordered row track definitions using intrinsic, fixed, proportional, or constrained sizing.

attributes.name: columns
attributes.description: Ordered column track definitions using intrinsic, fixed, proportional, or constrained sizing.

constraints.expression: each child span is within declared tracks
constraints.message: Child placement must reference existing tracks.

accessibility.focusBehavior: container is not focusable; children follow declared semantic order
notes: Do not infer reading order solely from coordinates.

mappings.strategy: Normalize GridItem and cell placement into tracks and spans.
Map tracks to row and column definitions; use an items layout for repeated data.
